thread:
Oliver: Quick postmortem follow-up around rollout/canary fixes. We need owners, short ETAs, and a couple of safety knobs: auto-rollback, blast-radius caps, quarantine after rollback, and a flapping detector. Reply +1 if you own.
Tia: I can own the auto-rollback spec + the rollout-state metric. Will draft a minimal spec by Thu. Decision: support both relative_error and absolute_error thresholds; defaults sensible for each.
Noah: I'll take blast-radius caps and the PR checklist. Draft ETA: next Tue. Will include kill-switch CLI snippet and rollback_SLA field.
Oliver: Recurring pattern note: three ops hits where cache eviction + scaling spikes coincided. We should add an incident taxonomy entry and a repro eval.
Tia: I'll add a bench test that reproduces eviction + burst QPS by Mon. Will also add a test case in Optimize that fails the canary if p99 increase > 30% or error_rate increase > 0.02.
Noah: Proposal for default staged rollout: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% with min_rps at each stage. Initial 0.5% helps avoid noisy baselines.
Oliver: Auto-rollback config strawman (pseudo-yaml):
```
feature_flag:
  id: new_search_v2
  rollout_stages: [0.5, 2, 10]
  min_rps_per_stage: [50, 200, 1000]
  monitors:
    error_rate: {absolute_threshold: 0.01, relative_threshold: 0.25}
    p99_latency_ms: {relative_threshold: 0.30}
  auto_rollback:
    enabled: true
    mode: relative_error # or absolute_error for 5xx-heavy flows
    window_sec: 300
    cooldown_min: 15
    quarantine_min: 30   # block retries for 30m after rollback
    flapping_threshold: 2 # consecutive rollbacks triggers manual review
```
Tia: Add rollout-state metric with fields: pct_exposed, error_delta, last_rollback_ts, consecutive_rollbacks. Dashboard alert when pct_exposed >= 10 OR consecutive_rollbacks >= 2 AND error_delta > threshold.
Noah: PR checklist items: owner, risk_level, rollout_stages, min_rps, observables, rollback_SLA (propose 3m critical / 10m non-critical), kill_switch_cmd, post-rollback_steps, incident_link.
Oliver: Ops req: zero-default on max_pct (teams must opt up from 0). Critical paths need SRE sign-off before >2% exposure.
SRE-bot: Created INF-8015: "canary guardrails - spec + telemetry" and assigned @Tia @Noah.
Tia: I'll include a short oncall playbook snippet: how to interpret the alert, immediate kill-switch, and how to mark flag as quarantined in the UI.
Noah: I'll add a short CLI example for rollback: `rw flags set new_search_v2 --pct 0 --reason "auto-rollback"` and add a changelog tag.
Oliver: Ownership summary:
- Auto-rollback spec + rollout-state metric: Tia (draft Thu) / Oliver review
- Blast-radius caps + PR checklist: Noah (draft Tue) / Tia review
- Eviction + burst eval: Tia + Noah (bench Mon)
- Dashboard alerts + playbook: Tia (alerts Mon) / SRE review
Oliver: Please update INF-8015 with ETA and link back to the postmortem doc. I'll pull status at next remediation sync. Thanks. :thumbsup:
